title: Tutorial passwords in connection URIs: must be flagged
summary: Connection URIs whose password is a synthetic literal. Only the password bytes are the secret; the scheme, user and host are not. Covers 5 inputs.
rationale: Tutorials and quickstarts ship default passwords that are not secrets. The same URI shape with a literal password is a real leak, so the password value, not the URI shape, decides.

expectation.rationale: Issue-specific literal/password range; expectations are the project’s masking policy.
